summary: Create a Proxy exotic object only with new, requiring object target and handler and installing internal methods according to target capabilities.

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.identity: returns distinct Proxy exotic object with target/handler internal slots
semantics.callability: [[Call]] exists only if target is callable
semantics.constructability: [[Construct]] exists only if target is constructable

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.

tests.name: invalid target or call form throws
